note: Internal motion vernacular of FinalPost. Not Jitter assets. Mirrors MOTION_RECIPES (a test keeps it equal).

recipes.feel: Scale 0.4 -> overshoot -> 1 on a springy curve, with a blur that clears as it lands (Snappy / Elastic Text).
recipes.defaultHosts: OpenPlate title block (default); QuoteCallout mark; captions: scale / pop / type active word and typed looks

recipes.feel: A horizontal smear: the layer is stretched and blurred along x and slides in, then snaps sharp (Stretch Blur).
Characters arrive one after another, each leaving a fading ghost of itself behind it (Type Trail).
recipes.defaultHosts: none by default (text form: pass `text`); variety pool for list / hook

recipes.feel: Glyphs flicker through random letters and lock onto the real ones left to right.
recipes.defaultHosts: none by default (text form: pass `text`); variety pool for pivot / stat

recipes.feel: A horizontal slit opens from the centre line and the layer is revealed through it (Split Reveal).
recipes.defaultHosts: WikiCallout sheet (default); QuoteCallout block (default); seed default for evidence plates (Wiki, Newspaper, Tweet)

recipes.feel: Cartoon physics: stretched flat, squashed tall, overshoot, settle. Not a fade.
recipes.defaultHosts: StampTitle title (default); BigKineticHeadline lines (default); captions: bounce active word; seed default for punchline

recipes.feel: A number counts up on a snappy spring and the digits pop as they settle.
recipes.defaultHosts: StatHighlight number (default); seed default for stat

recipes.feel: Nested scale from the centre: the layer grows 0.6 -> 1 while its content counter-scales 1.25 -> 1 (Nested Images energy).
recipes.defaultHosts: NewspaperCallout and TweetCard sheet (host default; seeds pass split_mask_reveal)

recipes.feel: RGB split and horizontal jitter that settle into sharp type in a few stepped frames (Glitch Text Reveal). The split is a red / blue drop-shadow pair (never the karaoke blue-green).
A coarse checker grid reveals the layer and refines to nothing: the mask cells shrink 96 px -> 6 px while opacity climbs in four steps (Pixel Dissolve, lite).
A blobby pop: x and y overshoot out of phase with a slight tilt, so the layer wobbles like a gooey blob before it settles. Motion only: no backing card.
A slight spin and blur resolving to sharp upright type (Blurry Text Spin, lite): rotate 14 deg -> 0, blur 12 px -> 0, scale 0.92 -> 1.
A logo HIT: it slams in from 0.2 scale, overshoots to ~1.18, rocks a few degrees and settles (Jitter logo reveal). Motion only.
recipes.defaultHosts: ImageRun logo items (default for logo uploads); labeled-asset logo pips (overlay `recipeId`); logo_cloud hero

recipes.feel: An elastic sticker pop: scale 0.3 -> overshoot -> 1 with a small rotate wiggle that dies out (KLIPY stickers, emoji).
recipes.defaultHosts: KLIPY sticker / GIF overlays (overlay `recipeId`); labeled product pips; logo_cloud background variety

recipes.feel: A slow camera push on a still: scale 1.12 -> 1 over ~60 % of the hold with a soft blur that clears in the first frames (Ken Burns, not a fade).
recipes.defaultHosts: ImageRun person / still items; labeled-asset person cards (overlay `recipeId`)

recipes.feel: A card swung in under perspective: rotateY 16 deg and rotateX 10 deg settle to 0 while the scale lands 0.9 -> 1 (article / screenshot as a physical object).
recipes.defaultHosts: labeled-asset screenshot cards (overlay `recipeId`); NewspaperCallout / WikiCallout / TweetCard on every second seed variant

recipes.feel: CONTINUOUS: a very slow drift (a few px, ~1.5 deg) on two out-of-phase sines for the whole hold; a short blur-clear entrance. For logo-cloud background items.
recipes.defaultHosts: ImageRun logo_cloud background items (continuous drift over the hold)
